cf62a1efdfa13ee7eeaa1765667fa7e7b6ece3fe.source:
以还中炮对抗“仙人指路”，是一种强硬的应法， 其作战意图是以攻为守，
力争主动。是王嘉良、杨官●近几年来喜用的开局战术，这种布局虽然容易演成先
手屏风马对后手中炮阵式，从理论上一般认为先手主动，后手吃亏。但是王、杨两
位特级大师，雄风不减当年，采用这种具有挑战性的着法，敢于争斗，取得过显著
的效果，丰富了“兵”“炮”争雄的新变化。
cf62a1efdfa13ee7eeaa1765667fa7e7b6ece3fe.text:
Using the Central Cannon to counter the "Pawn Opening" is a forceful reply. Its strategic idea is to attack in defense,
and to strive for the initiative. This is an opening strategy favored by Wang Jialiang and Yang Guanlin in recent years. Although this setup can easily transpose into an initiative-bearing Screen Horse Defense versus a second-player Central Cannon formation, theory generally holds that the first player has the initiative and the second player is at a disadvantage. However, the two grandmasters Wang and Yang, still vigorous as ever, have adopted this challenging approach, daring to fight on and achieving striking results, enriching the new variations in the struggle between "Pawn" and "Cannon" for supremacy.
